title: EZKinetics input
description: Enzymes and substrates; every enzyme-substrate pair is predicted at one set of assay conditions. Sequence length has no limit yet; the GPU profile will set one.

id.description: Must start with a letter or digit, so it cannot be read as a spreadsheet formula when written to CSV.

sequence.description: One-letter amino acid codes; the 20 standard residues only. Residues past 1022 are ignored, as in training; the frontend warns before submission.

id.description: Must start with a letter or digit, so it cannot be read as a spreadsheet formula when written to CSV.

smiles.description: Substrate SMILES. No whitespace, and no leading =, +, - or @, so it cannot be read as a spreadsheet formula when written to CSV.

ph.description: Assay pH, applied to every pair.

temperature.description: Assay temperature in degrees Celsius, applied to every pair.
